aboutSection.title: ABOUT
paragraphs: AlienX was born from the passion for storytelling through digital media. We are an independent studio dedicated to creating gaming experiences that transcend common entertainment.
Each project is developed with meticulous attention to detail, combining deep narrative, innovative mechanics, and art that transports players to extraordinary worlds.
We believe games have the power to move, teach, and connect people in unique ways. Our mission is to create titles that leave a lasting mark on the memory of those who play.

footer.description: Independent studio dedicated to creating unique and memorable gaming experiences. Digital worlds that challenge and enchant.

starBind.description: A stellar adventure where you connect stars to save the galaxy on an epic journey.
starBind.longDescription: Face the unknown as Lazlo in this frenetic action rogue-lite. Explore endless combinations of skills and star equipment to overcome relentless confrontations. The difference lies in the 'Stars', your battle allies that grow with you: unlock permanent upgrades using stardust and refine your strategy with each survival attempt. Master.

vaporStories.description: Engaging stories in a world of steam and mystery, exploring deep narratives.
vaporStories.longDescription: The world is no longer the same. In this Victorian reality, steam technology has reached an unimaginable peak, giving life to robots designed to serve. However, a miscalculation in the artificial intelligence of these machines has led to an implacable logical conclusion: for society to evolve, human interaction must be eradicated. Now, citizens are captured and isolated in an attempt by the machines to 'optimize' the world.

cellWars.description: Epic battles in a cellular universe, where cells fight for supremacy.
cellWars.longDescription: Dive into the primordial struggle for existence in Cell Wars, a strategy game focused on evolution and microscopic survival. Take control of a primitive organism and manage biological battles in a fierce environment where only the fittest thrive. The core gameplay allows you to strategically build and customize your cell, adapting your genes to hunt, reproduce, and dominate the ecosystem. Overcome natural selection and secure the future of your lineage in a combat where every mutation counts.

ecoCityPlanner.description: Plan and build eco-friendly cities in a sustainable future.
ecoCityPlanner.longDescription: Take on the role of urban consultant in Eco City Planner, a strategic simulator that uses card mechanics for sustainable city development. On a dynamic grid, every building requires precise management: your choices directly impact energy levels, pollution, and the economy. Anticipate environmental events and balance resources in real-time to transform unexplored territories into resilient metropolises. Here, smart planning is your greatest survival tool.

heroVs1000.description: Face enemy hordes in epic battles against a thousand adversaries.
heroVs1000.longDescription: Face an extreme survival challenge in Hero Vs 1000, an action game focused on horde combat and precision. Traverse three historical eras — Medieval, Piracy, and Modern — taking control of heroes with unique fighting styles. Your mission is clear: annihilate 1000 opponents per stage to advance. With a progression system focused on unlocking weapons and mastery achievements, the game demands quick reflexes and strategy to manage relentless crowds of simultaneous enemies.

officeHero.description: Survive the challenges of the corporate world in an office adventure.
officeHero.longDescription: In a world where office work is an adventure, you must navigate the challenges of daily corporate life while unraveling mysteries and making unexpected allies.

presskit.title: Press Kit
presskit.companyDescription: AlienX is an independent development studio from Rio de Janeiro focused on transforming complex programming concepts into intuitive visual experiences and engaging games.

hero.title: CREATING IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCES
hero.subtitle: A studio founded by gamers, for gamers.

history.originText: AlienX is a development studio founded by game development graduates, players, and artists. We believe in cross-platform play: we want everyone to play together, regardless of their chosen platform.
history.trajectoryText: Based in Rio de Janeiro and founded on December 28, 2016, our mission is clear: to provide the best possible experience in immersive games, creating charismatic characters and engaging gameplay.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: AlienX Game Studio values user privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your information when you use our services.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: We may collect personal information such as name, email address, app usage data, and device technical information when you interact with our games and services.

dataUsage.title: Use of Information
dataUsage.content: We use your information to improve our games, provide customer support, send important updates, and personalize your gaming experience.

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing
dataSharing.content: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share aggregated and anonymized data for analytical purposes or as required by law.

dataSecurity.title: Information Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

userRights.title: User Rights
userRights.content: You have the right to access, correct, delete, or limit the processing of your personal information. Contact us to exercise these rights.

contact.title: Contact Information
contact.content: For questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at: privacy@alienx.com or visit our contact page.
